title: BENEDIKTAS ČIRBA WINS THE FIA INTERCONTINENTAL DRIFTING CUP

headline: ČIRBA WINS
THE FIA DRIFTING
CUP IN GREECE
data.body: Lithuania's Benediktas Čirba beat Latvia's Martins Immermanis in the final for his first FIA Intercontinental Drifting Cup win. Stavros Gryllis took third and Greece won the Nations Cup at home.

caption:
First FIA Intercontinental Drifting Cup win for Benediktas Čirba. He beat Martins Immermanis in the final at Serres, Stavros Gryllis took P3 and Greece won the Nations Cup in front of 3,000+ fans. 🏆
